summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository, but I did not run any tests, as instructed. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on it, reset clears it, capture rules in update/advance inside the lock, new TimeElapsedColumn between bar and TimeRemainingColumn); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with Added entries for TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__); tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (import, test_time_elapsed_column, column added to test_columns, expected output updated). The test_columns expected output was derived by hand tracing the clock reads (elapsed values 0:00:37/0:00:36 at start, 0:01:00/0:00:45 frozen; bar widths 33->25 and 23->16; speed of second task now 1 byte/s), and the layout model reproduces the existing expected speeds and bar widths, but it is unverified by a test run. Docs were not updated. Nothing was committed.
